macros.name: catanshindent
macros.doc: The indentation of subsequent lines of the answer in \catques.

macros.name: catansindent
macros.doc: The indentation of the first line of the answer in \catques.

macros.name: catanssty
macros.doc: The style in which the answer will be printed in \catques.

macros.name: catcitationaftskip
macros.doc: The distance to skip after ending a catcitations environment.

macros.name: catcitationbefskip
macros.doc: The distance to skip prior to beginning a catcitations environment, before running \catcitetitle.

macros.name: catcitehindent
macros.doc: The indentation of subsequent lines in the citation itself (that is, the quotation) in a \catcite.

macros.name: catciteindent
macros.doc: The indentation of the first line of the citation itself (that is, the quotation) in a \catcite.

macros.name: catcitesty
macros.doc: The style in which the citation itself (that is, the quotation) will be printed in \catcite.

macros.name: catcitetitlesty
macros.doc: The style in which \catcitetitle will print its contents.

macros.name: catcitetitleword
macros.doc: The word which the \catcitetitle command will print.

macros.name: catcommsty
macros.doc: The style in which the comment will be printed in \catcomment.

macros.name: catexplicsty
macros.doc: The style in which the comment will be printed in \catexplic.

macros.name: catqueshindent
macros.doc: The indentation of subsequent lines of the question in \catques.

macros.name: catquesindent
macros.doc: The indentation of the first line of the question in \catques.

macros.name: catquesnumwd
macros.doc: The width of the box in which catechis typesets the question number.

macros.name: catquessty
macros.doc: The style in which the question will be printed in \catques.

macros.name: catsrchindent
macros.doc: The indentation of subsequent lines in the source in a \catcite.

macros.name: catsrcindent
macros.doc: The indentation of the first line of the source in a \catcite.

macros.name: catsrcsty
macros.doc: The style in which the source will be printed in \catcite.

envs.name: catcitations
envs.doc: catechis provides an environment, catcitations, which will insert appropriate spacing before and after the citations.
